title: Reciprocal Lie-Algebra Structures: Paired Closure, Exchange Symmetry, and the Interpretation of Ontological Two-Sidedness
summary: This paper examines whether reciprocal representation provides a mathematically coherent way to express two distinguishable but structurally equivalent sectors without privileging either as primary. The starting point is a pair of isomorphic Lie algebras and their representation within a direct-sum algebra. A natural sector-exchange map is shown to be an involutive Lie-algebra automorphism, while the paired representation forms a Lie subalgebra fixed pointwise by that exchange.
